verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that YAML-based agent/task configs can be 'version controlled' (crewai-docs-24), implying standard git-based versioning of config files, but there is no documented in-product review workflow or rollback mechanism for crews/flows/deployments. missing for 10: dedicated review/approval workflow, rollback/restore of deployed crews or flows, versioned deployment history in enterprise offering.
